programs.title: The Adventures Of Buckaroo Banzai Across The 8th Dimension
programs.desc: In this cult classic, neurosurgeon, physicist and rock star Buckaroo Banzai (Peter Weller) is ready to save the world when the evil Red Lectroids -- led by the deranged Lord John Whorfin (John Lithgow) -- are unleashed from the 8th dimension.

programs.title: Tank Girl
programs.desc: In this laugh-a-minute, futuristic thriller, a mega-villain (Malcolm McDowell, "The Passage") controls the world's water supply, and it's up to Tank Girl (Lori Petty, "Cadillac Man") and her outrageous cohorts to end his greedy reign.

programs.title: Dark Angel
programs.desc: Detective Jack Caine (Dolph Lundgren) thought he;d dealt with every kind of crime on earth, but someone "or something" is using human bodies to manufacture narcotics.

programs.title: Masters Of The Universe
programs.desc: The evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) is poised to conquer the universe. But fear not! He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) has declared war on Skeletor, and the battle between good and evil has come to Earth. Courtney Cox also stars in the epic, action-adventure.

programs.title: Mad Max
programs.desc: In the ravaged near-future, a brutal motorcycle gang rules the road, terrorizing innocent civilians. But they underestimate one cop: Max (Mel Gibson). When the bikers brutalize Max's family, they send him into a mad frenzy and a need for revenge!

programs.title: Red Dawn
programs.desc: The invasion has begun! Patrick Swayze, C. Thomas Howell, Lea Thompson and Charlie Sheen wage unremitting guerilla warfare in defense of their parents, their friends, their town and their country when Communist invaders storm their hometown.
